static_traits.name: 韩以森
static_traits.family_status: 有一个孩子，最近Graduated from university
static_traits.social_status: 有几位可以倾诉的亲密朋友，但尚not yet与他们讨论负性思维模式
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy; no notable physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 逻辑清晰、配合度尚可；表达Anxiety明显、反复Self-doubt；倾向用绝对化与最坏结果的表述；对正向反馈持怀疑态度

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常进行非黑即白的思维，如果not能完全达成目标，就认为一切都是失败。这种思维模式影响了我的动力和整体幸福感。
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes negative thinking patterns are affecting daily life and self-esteem, and therefore seeks counseling to address these thoughts.
growth_experiences: 开始参加三项赛后，逐渐形成以“完全达成目标才算成功”的标准来评估自我，若目标not yet充分达成就认定为失败。这一模式逐步影响到日常跑步与其他个人目标，导致Decreased drive。
Female儿Graduated from university进入空巢期后，压力显著增加，相关消极思维（如把not完美表现视为全面失败）进一步加剧，伴随自我失望与Reduced motivation。
在一次外科手术中出现过一个小失误，虽及时纠正且not yet造成伤害，但自那以后反复担心再次犯错会毁掉职业与形象，并在工作决策中持续发生灾难化联想与强烈Anxiety。

core_beliefs: Making a mistake means failure，且会毁掉一切

special_situations.event: Running only one mile during the daily run
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not完全达成训练目标，就说明我失败了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces oneself to train harder and doubles the demands to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I only ran one mile today; my whole goal is ruined

special_situations.event: 在一次外科手术中出现小失误（已及时纠正且without伤害）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake is enough to ruin a career and make me be seen as a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自我安抚并向同事寻求肯定以缓解not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will lose my job, ruin my career, and be seen as a failure

special_situations.event: Female儿Graduated from university后进入空巢期
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在have not家庭角色支撑时，必须完美达成个人目标才能证明自身价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher expectations and pushes oneself on personal goals such as triathlons
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我not能把个人目标做到最好，我就一without是处

special_situations.event: Discusses with colleagues and receives their positive feedback and comfort
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有得到他人的认可，我才可以证明自己not是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁寻求他人安慰与认可来短暂缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果同事not能肯定我，就说明我not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and reliable, to maintain a sense of achievement and safety
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as a failure after making mistakes, losing work and important relationships
defense_goal: 通过维持完美标准与寻求外部肯定来避免失败与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 随时可能失败、需要证明自己的not够好的执行者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是评判者或not可信的安慰者（给予肯定但难以被相信）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When colleagues or the counselor downplay mistakes, give positive feedback or affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的安慰理解为not真实或not可靠，认为他们not理解真实风险
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持强调最坏结果，use绝对化（“一定”“彻底”）措辞，忽略正面证据与安慰。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling that small mistake or facing critical decisions at work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把一次失误等同于全面失败与职业destruction，以此RationalizationPersistent anxiety与自我苛责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以“风险”“后果”作为理由not断强调最坏可能，用条理化论证来维持负面结论并回避接纳not确定性。

manifestations: Female儿毕业进入空巢期后感到压力上升，内在支持角色减少
Relies more on perfect performance and achievement for self-worth and sense of purpose

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 大量use“必须/完全达成”的内在规则评判自己
以完美达成为唯一成功标准，not yet加检视其适用性

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在工作中反复Self-doubt、二次猜测每个决定
Fears making mistakes and is overly cautious, hard to accept positive feedback

exception_events.target_problem: 在工作中出现失误时，来访者通常会灾难化思维、强烈Anxiety并认定职业可能因此被毁
exception_events.unique_outcome: 那次外科手术的小失误后，来访者迅速纠正错误且not yet造成伤害，表现出及时应对与责任感
exception_events.reason: not同做法：及时采取纠正措施；not同支持：同事反馈认为失误not严重，提供了现实性信息

positive_force: 在压力情境下仍有Good专业表现的记录
Able to quickly correct mistakes and take responsibility
Having a few friends and colleagues to confide in for support
negative_force: Excessively dependent on external approval and finds it hard to accept positive feedback

target_behavior.behavior: 在目标not yet完全达成或发生小失误时出现Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking并伴随强烈Anxiety
antecedent: Facing challenges at work or recalling past small mistakes
Increased pressure on personal goals after the empty-nest transition
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth is highly bound to perfect attainment and zero errors, and she worries that external evaluation will regard her as a failure
target_behavior.function: 通过绝对化与最坏情境预设来获得短期的确定感与控制感、逃避not确定性与失败感
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety、Sleep impaired、Decreased drive，雪上加霜地影响工作表现与Interpersonal relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeks comfort and recognition from others (repeatedly confirming with colleagues)
antecedent: 在工作中感到Anxiety或出现错误后
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在自我评价not稳，试图依靠他人认可来证明自己not是失败者
target_behavior.consequence: 缓解短暂但对肯定难以信任，Reinforcement对外部认可的依赖并维持负性思维循环
